name: Progress
description: Linear progress primitive. Determinate indicates known completion; indeterminate communicates ongoing work without a measurable endpoint.

type.determinate: Progress is known and reported as a proportion of a total.
type.indeterminate: Progress is unknown — show activity, not a percentage.

dos: Reference variables for every value; never hardcode a hex or px.
Change state through props, never by detaching the instance.
Use the determinate form whenever a total is known.
Say what is happening in text beside the bar.
Keep it in place until the work actually finishes.
donts: Do not let a bar sit at 100% without resolving.
whenToUse: Show that work is underway, and how far along it is when that is known.
whenNotToUse: Waits short enough that the indicator flashes — show nothing.
Content-shaped placeholders while a view loads — use Skeleton.

notes: Determinate sets aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, and aria-valuemax.
Named by aria-labelledby, or aria-label when no visible label exists.

states.Type=Determinate: fill muted · radius radius/lg · fill primary · (+1 variant share these)
